Game Overview

At its heart, Brothers are making a cake is a two-player game about race against time and your friend in this exhilarating cake-making showdown. Navigate whimsical platform levels, gathering ingredients from balloons to craft the ultimate cake. Precision, speed, and strategy are your allies in this 120-second dash to outsmart your opponent and achieve cake supremacy!
